exposure: Poor gestational sac and utero-placental juncture vascularization signal
Women with combined inherited thrombophilias vs. women with inherited thrombophilias who received LMWH therapy from the beginning of pregnancy (controls)
cohort: 219 pregnant women with poor gestational sac and utero-placental juncture vascularization signal, screened for inherited thrombophilias
finding: Screening for inherited thrombophilias in women with poor early pregnancy vascularization and subsequent treatment with LMWH appears to prevent adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was more common in the control group (p < .001), while all women in the study group (combined inherited thrombophilias) delivered by Cesarean section.
